unresolved_finding_ids: client navigation blanks the whole document for the duration of the loader request: route loaders suspend to the root boundary. A SuspenseBoundary below the Router makes the server stream fallbacks (no content without JS, 404 status lost) - see use_after_suspense_resolved in dioxus-router Router. Needs a client-only boundary or loader-before-navigate; mitigated by the 8 s watchdog
